run_id.description: Run-scoped identity, stable across a run (including pause/resume). Not required: only FSMExecutor._emit()-routed events stamp it today (ENH-3345); parallel.*/issue.* emitters don't yet (ENH-3346).

loop.description: Loop name, stamped on every FSMExecutor._emit()-routed event (ENH-3345). Not required for the same reason as run_id.

output_preview.description: Short preview of output, null if none

is_prompt.description: True if action was a Claude prompt

session_jsonl.description: Path to Claude session JSONL file (prompt-only, null for shell commands)

model.description: Model ID reported by the host CLI (prompt/slash_command only)

state.description: FSM state whose action produced this event (ENH-3240; absent on archived runs and on the non-FSM ll-action emitter)

iteration.description: Executor step count when this action ran (ENH-3240; absent on archived runs and on the non-FSM ll-action emitter)

stderr_preview.description: Short preview of stderr output, null if none (ENH-2469)

effort.description: Reasoning effort level applied (prompt actions only, ENH-2885)

is_batch.description: True if the host CLI invocation was a batch request (FEAT-2716)
